description: BifacialSimu is a Python model for estimating the energy yield of photovoltaic panels that collect light on both sides. It accounts for irradiance arriving at the front and rear surfaces and represents ground reflectance, a key source of rear-side light. Users configure a PV layout and weather conditions, so geographic coverage and the production period are specific to that site and scenario. The JOSS paper and public repository identify reusable BSD-3-Clause source code. Yield estimates can help size a new solar installation or compare surface and module-layout options in an electricity-system simulation. A caveat is that reflectance, soiling and shading can change over time, and the software does not verify a built installation. Repository metadata provided a named software address, but no README was available at the common root filename, so detailed operating assumptions should be checked in the code documentation before adoption. No directly related catalogue record was established. The model was not executed.
inputs: Bifacial module layout and optical parameters
name: BifacialSimu photovoltaic yield model
